verdict.rationale: SerpApi is API-first, so its core function is delivered entirely through the REST API: scraping many engines, all regular Google search operators, location, device, and output format. The web playground is described as an interactive demo of that same API (serpapi-docs-30), and past searches can be retrieved programmatically via the Searches Archive API, async mode and the cache. However, nothing shows that UI and account features such as plan and renewal settings, ZeroTrace toggling, usage dashboards or billing are available through the API, and no OpenAPI spec exists to verify full coverage (probe 404). missing for 10: documented account/billing/settings API parity, a machine-readable spec covering full surface, independent confirmation that nothing is UI-only
